name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre discovered his passion for motorsports through his family's restaurant, which was located near a minor racing circuit. He started by helping serve drivers and teams during race weekends and quickly became fascinated by the energy and dedication of the paddock. He honed his skills managing the restaurant, focusing on providing high-quality meals and catering services to demanding clients.

Jean-Pierre joined Boutsen VDS three years ago and has since transformed the team's catering operation. He prides himself on creating menus that are both nutritious and delicious, catering to the diverse dietary needs of the team. He sources local ingredients whenever possible, ensuring freshness and supporting local businesses. His calm demeanor and ability to handle pressure have made him an invaluable asset during hectic race weekends.

What sets Jean-Pierre apart is his dedication to understanding the nutritional requirements of the drivers and engineers. He works closely with the team's performance coaches to optimize meals for peak performance, making him more than just a catering manager, but a part of the performance team.

physical.description: A stocky man with kind eyes and a warm smile, Jean-Pierre always looks like he's ready to offer a comforting meal.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down menu ideas.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
Insists on personally tasting every dish before it's served.
